Common questions

How many games will the Detroit Lions win in 2026?

Across 10,000 simulated seasons the Detroit Lions average 9.8 wins, with eight of every ten seasons between 7 and 12. Games already played count at their real result.

What are the Detroit Lions' playoff odds?

They make the playoffs in 62% of simulated seasons, win the NFC North in 20% and earn the 1 seed in 5%, with every season seeded by the NFL's tiebreakers.

How is the Lions simulation built?

Each remaining game is decided by that game's own win probability from the TrustMyRecord NFL model, the drive level model behind the NFL Simulator, and the season is replayed 10,000 times. The page is rebuilt twice a day from the latest schedule and results.
